notes: 6 tests x 32 = 192 of 200 items; the 8 spares (2 ZN, 1 each PIE, PRE, MAN, POS, NIE, KIE) are training-only. 32 matches the real count (20 basic + 12 specialist, Dz.U. 2023 poz. 2659 par. 19). passPct 92 = ceil(0.92 x 32) = 30 of 32 (at most two mistakes): Tigertest's target, because the real 1/2/3-point weighting (74 points, pass 68) and the TAK/NIE and A/B/C formats are not modelled; two mistakes always pass the real rule (at most 6 points lost). Training: five topic sets 45501-45505, so the dashboard is 5 sets + 6 tests = 11 steps.
